blinded_assessment.note: Opus 5.5 assessed randomized, anonymous outputs. Identical outputs share one assessment. The tables retain raw checker flags, which can include mistakes; per-example reasons are available in the reading desk. Meaning and fact changes are assessed relative to the common normalized input; recognizer and upstream-normalization errors are separate from damage introduced by cleanup. This is an automated assessment, not human adjudication; all unjudged outputs remain unverified.

flagged_case_inspection.note: Engineering inspection compares C, E and F on the same union of fresh checker-flagged cases and exact-reference regressions against C or E. Checker flags include unwanted edits and wrong cleanup. Raw flags remain available, and ambiguous interpretations are counted separately. This is not independent human adjudication or a count of errors the checker missed.

matched_timing.selection: First 30 frozen synthetic cases in the original order, chosen before inspecting final candidate quality. No case selected by outcome.
